job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. It does not specify a five-year retention period or a seven-year total ceiling; it says the term will be negotiated. Its draft agreement also provides for immediate termination rather than thirty days’ notice.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is being issued by the Texas Municipal Retirement System (“TMRS”).
The term of the initial contract will be negotiated and begin after approved by the Board of Trustees of TMRS.
TMRS may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice to Consultant for any reason or for no reason at any time during the Term of this Agreement
